claim_text: Reduced kidney function can impair magnesium excretion and increase risk of magnesium accumulation from supplements; magnesium glycinate remains a magnesium source and is not exempt from renal safety considerations.
health_goal_or_outcome: Support safe, evidence-based nutrient assessment and avoid unsupported or unnecessary supplementation.

population.other_context: People with kidney disease considering magnesium supplements, including glycinate.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Dietary and supplemental sources; verify exact product form and label.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Magnesium Health Professional Fact Sheet describes magnesium toxicity risk in impaired renal function.
limitations: No supplement dose from this claim; renal status and clinical context are essential.
Exact source passages and underlying evidence require full appraisal before approval.
